source.witness: Hieronymus de Moravia, Tractatus de musica, chapter 12
source.literal_observation: The text fixes six syllables (ut, re, mi, fa, sol, la), directed mutation rules, and explicit zero cases. Gamma ut, A re, and square-B mi have no mutation; C/D/E/F two-voice keys have two directed mutations; G sol re ut has six. Lower voices ascend and upper voices descend, cross-key voices do not mutate, and three-voice mutations follow first-last, first-middle, middle-last order.
